description: Native DD-GNG and DBL-GNG algorithm cores copied unchanged from the local TopoVLA checkout. The ROS-independent comparison adapter supplies metric world-coordinate XYZ points before either original core learns.
ddgng_source_resolution: TopoVLA/native_ddgng/src/main.cpp includes ddgng.hpp from ../native_depth_yolo/src, configured by native_ddgng/CMakeLists.txt.
adapter_notes: comparison_mapper.hpp performs depth backprojection, proper rigid world transformation, bounded input sampling, optional voxel memory/replay, and optional exported surface-support filtering outside the original cores.
DD-GNG preserves its original fixed random seed 7 and 500 stochastic updates per epoch by default.

DBL-GNG preserves its initialization, pruning and distributed growth rules. The ROS streaming adapter accumulates edge strength and invokes edge cutting periodically after the graph has first reached node capacity; the default period is 10 valid depth frames.
DBL-GNG exports array indices for graph IDs because the copied core does not expose persistent node identity. These indices must not be tracked as persistent landmarks.

Memory mode world adds the same observation memory used by F-GNG. Memory mode current supplies only the current bounded world-coordinate point cloud while retaining the original learned graph across frames. Neither mode applies foveation to the baseline algorithms.
Baseline graph() optionally filters exported edges by observed surface support; rawGraph() always exposes original baseline connectivity. With zero support radius, graph() equals rawGraph().
